meta.what: Model-based predictions for same-protein isoforms that differ only in the 5' leader (GENCODE v47).
meta.model: app/src/analytic.js expected() (deterministic expected value of the sim.js scanning model), perMin output
meta.robustness: every call holds at all 20 parameter points (default + every grid point where all 5 mechanism findings pass; grid scanSpeed x tcRate x loadTCexp) and for both fold methods (global MFE hairpins; local MFE max_bp_span=100 hairpins)
meta.input: GENCODE v47 pc_transcripts.fa (UTR5/CDS ranges) + gencode.v47.basic.annotation.gtf (tags, TSL)
meta.filters: protein_coding, tag basic, no mRNA_start_NF/cds_start_NF/readthrough, not PAR_Y, UTR5 from nt 1, CDS starts AUG, UTR length 10..1500 nt; grouped by gene + identical CDS nucleotide sequence; identical UTRs collapsed; groups with >= 2 distinct UTRs
meta.output_floor: the isoform a call is about must reach the 25th percentile of all isoforms' output (calm for leader_effect; stress for stress_flip, isr_escape, induced_isoform) at every point, so ratios of near-zero outputs are not called
meta.high_conf: both isoforms MANE_Select or transcript_support_level 1-2 (field both_high_conf); lists sorted high-conf first
meta.mechanism_note: mechanism = which ablation (all upstream AUGs disabled in both isoforms; all hairpins melted) makes the call fail at some point
caveats: Predictions from a scanning model with assumed (mostly unsourced) parameters; robustness across the feasible region is not validation.
GENCODE 5' ends are approximate TSSs; real leaders vary by a few to many nt.
The model has no IRES, RBP, m6A, uORF peptide-stalling (e.g. CHOP) or non-AUG uORF starts; calls depending on those are out of scope.
Same-CDS isoforms share their whole CDS, so Ribo-seq CDS reads cannot be assigned between them: the Cao 2021 TE validation uses only values not flagged ambiguous and is weak evidence either way.
